rationales.data-access.missing-org-filter: Spec 62 A1.3 — the fixture was legitimately broken: `const db = { query: async … }` is a bare mock with no driver import, so the analyzer never established DB provenance and never extracted `orders`/`users` — no missing-org-filter could fire. Fix: a real `drizzle(env.DB)` import (mirroring the non-english corpus), plus a `schemas` config that DECLARES `orders`/`users` as tenant (each carrying org_id). Tenancy is declared, not inferred from the deleted English fallback.

description: Tests for the data-access analyzer — SQL patterns with a real drizzle-orm provenance import. n-plus-one.ts: loop-query (N+1) + missing-org-filter on `orders`. clean-queries.ts: two tenant queries (`orders WHERE user_id = ANY($1)`, `users WHERE id = $1`) fire missing-org-filter but NOT loop-query (no loop) and NOT unfiltered-query (both have a WHERE). no-sql-signal.ts: plain-JS array/string/object methods — zero SQL findings.
